verdict.rationale: Apple's docs describe AirDrop for sending files between Mac, iPhone and iPad: pick a file from any folder, send it to the nearby device, and it works even without a Wi-Fi network. Universal Clipboard copy-paste of entire files between Macs and drag-and-drop of video from Mac to iPhone add further wireless transfer paths. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of AirDrop reliability and speed, since the community evidence does not address file transfer.
